stories.headline: Federal officials identify 400 noncitizens registered to vote in Washington state: 'Tip of the iceberg'
stories.note: Hundreds of noncitizens on a blue state's rolls backs up the GOP's push for election integrity.

stories.headline: DSA-affiliated Senate nominee sparks bipartisan uproar with comments on communist dictatorship
stories.note: A Democratic Senate nominee drawing fire from both parties over communism hands Republicans a gift a week before Election Day.

stories.headline: 175 Democrats demand Trump admin stop Ilhan Omar investigation, warn it could hurt her re-election bid
stories.note: Most of the Democratic caucus going to bat for Omar ties the whole party to her legal troubles.

stories.headline: Watchdog accuses DSA candidate of blurring charity, business and campaign: 'What happened to all that money?'
stories.note: Money questions around a socialist Democratic candidate give Republicans another line of attack.

stories.headline: Haitian illegal immigrant charged in Walmart killing entered US via Biden parole program: DHS
stories.note: Linking a killing to Biden's parole program keeps the border failures of the last administration front and center.

stories.headline: Rep Tom Tiffany claims Kamala Harris' visit signals weakness in David Crowley's Wisconsin campaign
stories.note: Tiffany frames Harris's late rescue trip as a sign Democrats are worried in Wisconsin.

stories.headline: Inside Melania Trump's secret diplomatic role in the Russia-Ukraine ceasefire deal
stories.note: A behind-the-scenes look at the first lady's role burnishes the Trump team's peacemaking record.
